paper_title: Nuclear decay anomalies as a signature of axion dark matter
suggested_experiment_name: JRC Tritium decay (3H nuclear decay anomaly axion search)
coupling_convention: 1/f_a in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 3 (x-axis is m_a in eV). NOT converted to the (f_a, m_a) orientation suggested in the hint.
notes: Paper analyses 12 years of JRC tritium (3H) beta-decay data to search for periodic variations induced by an oscillating QCD theta-angle from axion DM misalignment. Main result is an exclusion directly on the f_a-m_a plane (Fig. 3 plots 1/f_a vs m_a), so AxionMass is the correct type. Only the two endpoint values are stated explicitly in text: f_a < 9.4e12 GeV at m_a = 1.7e-23 eV and f_a < 1.8e10 GeV at m_a = 8.7e-21 eV; the limit scales approximately as f_a ∝ 1/m_a between them (signal amplitude ∝ 1/(m_a^2 f_a^2)). Assumes rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. Projections for future fiducial experiments (f_a < 1.5e16 GeV over 5.4e-25 to 1.4e-17 eV; f_a < 4.5e11 GeV over 2.4e-21 to 6.3e-14 eV) are also discussed but the primary result is the measured JRC limit. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 35)) | Vision: The paper's new result is the dark-red 'Tritium decay' wedge in Fig. 3, plotted on the m_a [eV] vs 1/f_a [GeV^-1] plane (x: 1e-25 to 1e-12 eV; y: 1e-22 to 1e-2 GeV^-1). The caption gives the exclusion explicitly: f_a below 9.4e12 GeV at m_a = 1.7e-23 eV, down to f_a below 1.8e10 GeV at m_a = 8.7e-21 eV (95% CL). These endpoints correspond to 1/f_a = 1.06e-13 and 5.56e-11 GeV^-1; the boundary between them is very close to a straight slope-~1 line on the log-log plot (consistent with the I(theta) ~ 1/(m_a f_a)^2 signal scaling), with only small periodogram wiggles too fine to resolve. Points were generated along this line anchored to the two quoted endpoints. Lower boundary = smallest excluded 1/f_a (largest excluded f_a); region above (higher 1/f_a, lower f_a) is excluded. Other shaded regions (nEDM, SN1987A, BBN, pulsars, black hole spins, etc.) are prior constraints, not the paper's result. DM density assumed rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 per Eq. (12). Coupling type labeled AxionMass since the result is on the f_a-m_a plane, but per the plotted-values contract the emitted couplings are 1/f_a in GeV^-1 as shown on the axis. | Calibration: No calibration needed (spot-check verify/stage2 raw_ratio=0.97 snapped to identity)
